graph.title: Stephanie and Mailbox (30105)
notes: Piece counts match the parts list exactly (37 pieces).

The graph has three groups on purpose; this is not a mistake. (1) The lime mailbox, b1-b5, is a separate model that page 1 of the booklet builds on its own. It never attaches to the stall, and the final picture shows it standing beside the stall and Stephanie. (2) The flower stall with its roof and heart, b6-b36, is one connected model. (3) The printed tile b37 is the letter Stephanie holds. The booklet shows it only in her hand, and her minifigure parts are not in the parts list. Joining it to the mailbox or the stall would invent a connection the booklet does not show.
The booklet pictures are small. Several rests_on relations and the exact stud positions are my best reading of the pictures, especially the slopes, hinge and cones in main-build steps 1-4.
Assumed the hinge-top plate b11 and the two slopes support the top plate b14.
Assumed the black plate b22 carries the two pink and two brown round plates.
The roof (page 2, steps 1-3) is a separate sub-assembly, built on plate b27 and then set on the two gold supports. That joins it to the stall.
The heart (b35 and b36) is two red 3x2 rounded plates, one stacked on the other.
